java.say: Bird has a private field name. Only Bird's own code can use it.
Penguin extends Bird: a Penguin is a Bird, and it gets Bird's public methods.
The Penguin constructor passes the name on to the Bird constructor. Penguin cannot set the private field itself.
dive() changes Penguin's own field dives.
To show the name, Penguin calls getName(), which it inherited from Bird.
